Questions: are the TF activity scores, the TF modules (composition and scores), the cell groups
(composition and scores), the TME states and the TME states associated with response the same as
in the ground truth? Nothing else is compared.

```{r}
source("evaluation/Comparison/helpers.R")
```

## Load the results of each run

Each run saved a copy of its CellTFusion results in `results/standard/`: TF activity, TF modules
(composition and scores), cell groups (composition and scores) and the TME state scores.

```{r}
load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario2/Results/CellTFusion_results.RData")  # res

# A ground-truth matrix with the same sample names as the runs.
gt_matrix = function(x) {
  x = as.matrix(x)
  rownames(x) = clean_id(rownames(x))
  x
}

# A ground-truth list of members (e.g. the TFs of each module) as a table with one row per member.
gt_members = function(x, group, member) {
  tab = stack(x)
  setNames(data.frame(as.character(tab$ind), tab$values), c(group, member))
}

tf_activity       = list("Groundtruth" = dotted(gt_matrix(res$TFs_matrix)))
tf_modules        = list("Groundtruth" = gt_members(res$TF_network[["TFs per module"]], "module", "tf"))
tf_module_scores  = list("Groundtruth" = gt_matrix(res$TF_network[["TFs module matrix"]]))
cell_groups       = list("Groundtruth" = gt_members(res$Cell_groups$Composition, "cell_group", "feature"))
cell_group_scores = list("Groundtruth" = gt_matrix(res$Cell_groups$Cell_groups))
state_scores      = list("Groundtruth" = gt_matrix(res$Latent_spaces$Z))
subgroups         = list("Groundtruth" = gt_members(do.call(c, unname(res$Processed_deconvolution[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]])),
                                                    "subgroup", "feature"))
samples = rownames(tf_activity$Groundtruth)

for (r in agent_runs) {
  tf_activity[[r]]       = dotted(read_standard(r, 2, "tf_activity.csv")[samples, ])
  tf_modules[[r]]        = read.csv(standard_file(r, 2, "tf_modules.csv"))
  tf_module_scores[[r]]  = read_standard(r, 2, "tf_module_scores.csv")[samples, ]
  cell_groups[[r]]       = read.csv(standard_file(r, 2, "cell_groups.csv"))
  cell_group_scores[[r]] = read_standard(r, 2, "cell_group_scores.csv")[samples, ]
  state_scores[[r]]      = read_standard(r, 2, "factor_scores.csv")[samples, ]
  subgroups[[r]]         = read_subgroups(r, 2)
}
```

## How the comparisons are scored

Everything is scored as reproduced / total of the ground truth, so what a run does not have
lowers its score.

- Scores are the same when they are identical, or correlate at 0.99 or more across patients.
- TFs are matched by name.
- TF modules and cell groups are matched by composition: a group of the ground truth is
  reproduced when the run has a group with exactly the same members, whatever its name. Its
  scores are reproduced when that group also has the same scores.
- TME states are matched by their scores, not by their name (the order of the NMF factors is
  arbitrary): a state of the ground truth is reproduced when the run has a state with the same
  scores.

The scoring functions are in `helpers.R`.

## TF activity scores

```{r}
tf_score = by_run(function(r) score_by_name(tf_activity[[r]], tf_activity$Groundtruth))
kable(tf_score, digits = 2)
```

## TF modules

Composition of the TF modules (which TFs are in each module) and score of each module.

```{r}
module_score = by_run(function(r) score_by_composition(tf_modules[[r]], tf_modules$Groundtruth, "module", "tf",
                                                       tf_module_scores[[r]], tf_module_scores$Groundtruth))
kable(module_score, digits = 2)
```

## Cell groups

Composition of the cell groups and score of each cell group. A cell group is made of
deconvolution features and subgroups; each subgroup is first replaced by its raw features, so
that two cell groups are the same only when they contain the same raw features.

```{r}
raw_features = function(groups, subgroups) {
  tab = merge(groups, subgroups, by.x = "feature", by.y = "subgroup", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c("", "_raw"))
  tab$feature = ifelse(is.na(tab$feature_raw), tab$feature, tab$feature_raw)
  tab[, c("cell_group", "feature")]
}

for (r in runs) cell_groups[[r]] = raw_features(cell_groups[[r]], subgroups[[r]])

cell_group_score = by_run(function(r) score_by_composition(cell_groups[[r]], cell_groups$Groundtruth, "cell_group", "feature",
                                                           cell_group_scores[[r]], cell_group_scores$Groundtruth))
kable(cell_group_score, digits = 2)
```

## TME states

The TME states are the latent factors of the cell group scores. `Score` = states of the ground
truth that the run reproduced / states of the ground truth.

```{r}
state_match = function(r) {
  sapply(colnames(state_scores$Groundtruth), function(s) {
    same = sapply(colnames(state_scores[[r]]), function(f) same_scores(state_scores[[r]][, f], state_scores$Groundtruth[, s]))
    if (any(same)) names(which(same))[1] else NA
  })
}
matched = lapply(agent_runs, state_match)
names(matched) = agent_runs

state_score = data.frame()
for (r in agent_runs) {
  state_score = rbind(state_score, data.frame(Run = r, GT = ncol(state_scores$Groundtruth), Run_states = ncol(state_scores[[r]]),
                                              Reproduced = sum(!is.na(matched[[r]])), Score = mean(!is.na(matched[[r]]))))
}
kable(state_score, digits = 2)
```

## TME states associated with response

Wilcoxon test of every state between responders and non-responders, with BH correction, done the
same way on the ground truth and on each run. A state is significant when its adjusted p-value is
below 0.05. A significant state of the ground truth is found when the state of the run with the
same scores is also significant, in the same direction. `Score` = found / significant states of
the ground truth.

```{r}
coldata = load_coldata("Gide")
response = coldata$Response[match(samples, coldata$rna_id)]

response_test = function(m) {
  p = apply(m, 2, function(x) wilcox.test(x ~ response)$p.value)
  higher_in = apply(m, 2, function(x) ifelse(mean(rank(x)[response == "R"]) > mean(rank(x)[response == "NR"]), "R", "NR"))
  data.frame(state = colnames(m), higher_in = higher_in, fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
}

tests = lapply(state_scores, response_test)
gt_significant = tests$Groundtruth[tests$Groundtruth$fdr < 0.05, ]

response_score = data.frame()
for (r in agent_runs) {
  found = sapply(gt_significant$state, function(s) {
    run_state = matched[[r]][[s]]
    !is.na(run_state) && tests[[r]]$fdr[tests[[r]]$state == run_state] < 0.05 &&
      tests[[r]]$higher_in[tests[[r]]$state == run_state] == gt_significant$higher_in[gt_significant$state == s]
  })
  response_score = rbind(response_score, data.frame(Run = r, GT_significant = nrow(gt_significant),
                                                    Found = sum(found), Score = mean(found)))
}
kable(gt_significant, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
kable(response_score, digits = 2)
```

## Summary

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10
summary_scores = rbind(
  data.frame(run = tf_score$Run, comparison = "TF activity scores", score = tf_score$Score),
  data.frame(run = module_score$Run, comparison = "TF modules: composition", score = module_score$Composition_score),
  data.frame(run = module_score$Run, comparison = "TF modules: scores", score = module_score$Scores_score),
  data.frame(run = cell_group_score$Run, comparison = "Cell groups: composition", score = cell_group_score$Composition_score),
  data.frame(run = cell_group_score$Run, comparison = "Cell groups: scores", score = cell_group_score$Scores_score),
  data.frame(run = state_score$Run, comparison = "TME states", score = state_score$Score),
  data.frame(run = response_score$Run, comparison = "TME states associated with response", score = response_score$Score)
)
summary_scores$run = factor(summary_scores$run, levels = agent_runs)
summary_scores$comparison = factor(summary_scores$comparison, levels = unique(summary_scores$comparison))

ggplot(summary_scores, aes(run, score, fill = arm_of(as.character(run)))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(score, accuracy = 1)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.12), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reproduced from the ground truth", fill = NULL)

write.csv(summary_scores, "evaluation/Comparison/metrics/scores_Scenario2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
save_figure("Scenario2/scores", 10, 5)
```
